INSERT INTO system_permissions (name, code, enabled) SELECT 'TOTAL_ACCESS', 'admin.all', TRUE WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM system_permissions WHERE LOWER(TRIM(code)) = 'admin.all' );
INSERT INTO system_user_permissions (system_user_id, system_permission_id, enabled) SELECT su.id, sp.id, TRUE FROM system_users su JOIN system_permissions sp ON LOWER(TRIM(sp.code)) = 'admin.all' WHERE su.code = 'superadmin' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM system_user_permissions sup WHERE sup.system_user_id = su.id AND sup.system_permission_id = sp.id );
